//: Migrations are deliberately NOT run here. Vercel builds previews and production concurrently, and every one of them points at the same Supabase database, so `prisma migrate deploy` in the build step would race (parallel deploys applying the same migration) and would let a preview build mutate the production schema. Migrations are an explicit, serialised step: `npm run db:deploy` (see SUPABASE_SETUP.md).
